title: feat(automation): open action registry + fold built-in nodes into core (ADR-0018 M1+M2)
body:
## What & why

Implements **ADR-0018 M1 + M2**: make the automation engine's node/action vocabulary an **open, marketplace-extensible registry** instead of a closed enum, and make `automation` a **self-contained capability** — *plugins are plugins; the platform's foundational capabilities are built in.*

## M1 — open registry
- **spec**: canonical `ActionDescriptorSchema` (+ `defineActionDescriptor`); new `source: 'builtin' | 'plugin'` field; `FlowNodeSchema.type` becomes a validated `string` checked against the live registry at `registerFlow()` (soft-fail/warn, not a closed enum).
- **engine**: descriptor registry (`getActionDescriptors()` / `getActionDescriptor()`), published on `registerNodeExecutor` and dropped on `unregister`; `IAutomationService` gains optional `getActionDescriptors()`.

## M2 — built-ins are built in, and exposed over HTTP
- Fold logic / crud / screen-script / `http_request` executors into the core `AutomationServicePlugin` via `installBuiltinNodes()`. A bare `new AutomationServicePlugin()` now seeds all **10** built-in node types. The four `*NodesPlugin` classes become `register*Nodes(engine, ctx)` functions under `src/builtin/` (was `src/plugins/`).
- **Drop `connector_action` from the baseline** — it's an integration concern needing a connector registry the platform doesn't ship; third parties register it (and any node type) via the still-open `registerNodeExecutor()`.
- `capability-loader.ts` / `serve.ts`: remove the 4 `extras`; `automation` is now a single self-contained provider like every other capability.
- **`GET /api/v1/automation/actions`** via `HttpDispatcher.handleAutomation` (`?paradigm` / `?source` / `?category` filters), `AutomationActionsResponseSchema`, and a declarative entry in `DEFAULT_AUTOMATION_ROUTES`. Backs the designer palette + flow validation.

## Migration / compat
- Existing built-in flows keep working from the core plugin alone.
- Hosts that hand-assembled the four `*NodesPlugin` classes drop them (the classes are gone; the capability loader + CLI no longer reference them).

## Verification
- spec: **6604 tests** pass; build clean
- service-automation: **74 tests** pass (core plugin alone installs `decision, assignment, loop, get/create/update/delete_record, screen, script, http_request`)
- runtime: **105 http-dispatcher tests** pass (+5 for `/actions`: list, `/:name`-shadow guard, `?source`, `?paradigm`, missing-method empty registry); build clean
- cli build clean (full `tsc`)

## Follow-up (not in this PR)
- **M3**: outbox-backed `http` / `notify` (reuse `plugin-webhooks` outbox; register `http_request`/`http_call`/`webhook` as deprecated aliases).
- M4 (registry-driven designer palette), M5 (Workflow-Rule → Flow compiler).
